findings.summary: X-Request-Id is set after await next(); Hono's onError returns a fresh Response so the header is lost on error paths, breaking correlation for failing requests
findings.suggested_fix: Move c.res.headers.set('X-Request-Id', id) to before await next() (or also set in errorHandler before c.json(...)) so every response — success and error — carries the correlation id

findings.summary: Unknown errors are only logged when c.get('log') is populated; if logger middleware did not run (ordering bug) unknown errors are silently swallowed as 500
findings.suggested_fix: Fall back to the module-level pino logger from shared/logger.js when c.get('log') is undefined, so unknown errors are NEVER silently dropped regardless of middleware ordering

findings.summary: role column is declared as plain text with a Postgres CHECK; Drizzle TS type widens to string so insert call-sites lose the 'patient' | 'doctor' narrowing the DB enforces
findings.suggested_fix: Use text('role', { enum: ['patient', 'doctor'] as const }) so Drizzle narrows the TS type to the same literal union the CHECK enforces — accounts will inherit this user table per the task description

findings.summary: STATE_CHANGING_METHODS includes PUT while task spec and ARCHITECTURE §5.4 enumerate only POST/PATCH/DELETE; undocumented widening
findings.suggested_fix: Either drop 'PUT' from STATE_CHANGING_METHODS to match the spec, or leave a code comment + ARCHITECTURE §5.4 footnote that PUT is intentionally covered for forward compatibility

findings.summary: withRequestId(requestId) is called twice per request (pre-handler and post-handler); the second call rebuilds a child logger only to add userId
findings.suggested_fix: Capture the pre-handler child as `log`; after next() do `(userId ? log.child({ userId }) : log).info({ method, path, status, durationMs }, 'request.complete')` to avoid the second withRequestId invocation

findings.summary: middleware imports verifySessionToken directly from modules/auth/tokens.js; ARCHITECTURE §6.2 requires cross-module imports to go through <module>/index.ts (no auth/index.ts exists yet)
findings.suggested_fix: Planner: add apps/api/src/modules/auth/index.ts in the next wave re-exporting verifySessionToken (and other public-surface helpers); update authn.ts to import from '../modules/auth/index.js'
